title: Quantification of Fungal ITS Gene Copies Using ddPCR
author: Eva Petrova
materials: Prepare the master mix according to the number of samples and mix several seconds by vortexing. Transfer mix into 96-well plate à 20 µl. 20 µL, master mix per well ddPCR 96-well plates Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #12001925 QX200™ ddPCR™ EvaGreen Supermix Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1864033 Tip: use a mechanical or electronic dispenser (for ex. Multipette, Pipettman, or multichanel pipette) during this step to speed up the work.

Put all the staff (cartridges, tips, sealed plate with samples and empty 96-well plate in cooling stand) in corresponding amount inside the AutoDG machine (Bio-Rad). Per one sample there is a need of two pipette tips! This is an example how it should look like inside the AutoDG before strating droplets generation.
Make sure there is a right oil bottle ( Automated Droplet Generation oil for Probes ) connected to the system. Automated Droplet Generation Oil for EvaGreen Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1864112

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Equilibrate all reagents to room temperature (RT) and mix properly before use; do not keep them on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the master mix based on the number of samples and vortex for several seconds.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of QX200™ ddPCR™ EvaGreen Supermix (Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1864033) into each well of a 96-well plate (Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #12001925).
Tip: Use a mechanical or electronic dispenser (e.g., Multipette, Pipettman, or multichannel pipette) to increase speed.

steps.title: Add DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of the examined DNA sample into each well.

steps.title: Seal and Mix Plate
steps.instruction: Seal the plate and mix the contents.

substeps.instruction: Seal with pierceable aluminium foil (Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1814040) at 180°C for 5 seconds.
Allow the foil to cool down.
Vortex the plate vigorously for 30 seconds to 1 minute.

steps.title: Generate Droplets
steps.instruction: Generate droplets using the AutoDG machine.

substeps.instruction: Select the sample positions on the touch screen and start droplet generation.
Wait for the system to announce success or failure.
Perform a visual inspection to ensure two separated phases are visible: an upper part with droplets and a lower clear oil phase.

steps.title: Seal Plate for PCR
steps.instruction: Immediately seal the plate after droplet generation to stabilize the samples.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plate from the machine.
Seal with pierceable aluminium foil (Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1814040) at 170°C for 3 seconds.
Clean the AutoDG machine and dispose of used consumables.

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Place the sealed plate immediately into the PCR cycler and run the following program with a ramp rate of 2°C/sec and a reaction volume of 40 µL:

substeps.instruction: Initial denaturation: 95°C for 5 minutes
40 cycles of: 95°C for 30 seconds and 52°C for 2 minutes
Cool down: 4°C for 5 minutes
Activation: 90°C for 5 minutes
Hold: 10°C
After the run, check for the presence of two phases and let the plate cool down.

steps.title: Prepare Reader and Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the QX200 reader and load the sample plate.

substeps.instruction: Switch on the reader 30 minutes before measurement.
Check reader oil and waste levels (green control) on the left side of the machine.
If the instrument has not been used for more than a week, prime the machine (flush oil).
Place the plate into a metal holder and insert it into the QX200 reader.

steps.title: Configure QuantaSoft Experiment
steps.instruction: Set up the experiment in QuantaSoft with the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Experiment type: Absolute quantification (ABS)
Supermix: QX200 ddPCR EvaGreen Supermix
Target 1: Ch1 (for FAM labeled probes)
Define the position of each sample.

steps.title: Measure and Analyze Droplets
steps.instruction: Start the measurement and evaluate the droplet counts.

substeps.instruction: Verify that the total droplet count per sample is above 12,000 (typical range is 18,000 - 20,000) for reliable results.

steps.title: Set Threshold and Calculate Copies
steps.instruction: Set the threshold and determine the target gene copy number.

substeps.instruction: Set the threshold just above the negative control (NTC) sample to distinguish positive from negative droplets.
The software will calculate the copy number using the Poisson distribution algorithm (note: samples with only positive populations cannot be evaluated).

steps.title: Export and Recalculate Data
steps.instruction: Export the results and calculate the final concentration of the input DNA.

substeps.instruction: Export the .csv file containing concentrations (copies/µL) of the reaction.
Calculate the number of copies in 1 µL of input DNA using the formula: (concentration value x 22) / volume of DNA.
